warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Read from front.jpg (2516x1594), the image carrying all mandatory text; back.jpg is artwork printing 'Rossastro', 'Quasi Rosso - RST24' and 'FABIO SIGNORELLI'.
Net contents appear inside a pipe-separated line: 'ROSE WINE | ITALY | PRODUCT OF ITALY | 750 ML'. The alcohol statement is on the line below: '12% ALC. BY VOL. | CONTAINS SULFITES'.
Warning heading is in capitals and bold; the label sets the colon outside the bold run ('GOVERNMENT WARNING' bold, then ':').
